jobs.body:
Insurance Sales Representative
Hertvik Insurance Group
Medina, OH 44256
Hybrid Work

Apply Online:
https://www.indeed.com/viewjob?jk=38a73289f3ec5bce&tk=1jteiqirv22pd000&from=serp&vjs=3
 
About Us
Hertvik Insurance is a leading independent agency, passionately serving clients nationwide with comprehensive insurance solutions. From auto to commercial, we empower individuals and businesses to secure their future. Join our energetic team committed to delivering unparalleled service, diverse products, and significant savings, making a tangible difference in our clients' lives.

Job Overview
Hertvik Insurance Group is seeking a motivated, results-driven Sales Representative to join our Personal Lines team. This is a high-activity sales role focused exclusively on warm, referral-based leads. You'll be connecting with people who are actively purchasing a home and have a real, immediate need for homeowners insurance. Your job is simple: work the lead, earn their trust, quote the right coverage, and close the sale. Once the policy is sold, our service team takes it from there so you can stay focused on selling.

Benefits
Annual Base Salary + Commission + Bonus Opportunities
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Flexible Schedule
Health Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Hands on Training
Disability Insurance
Life Insurance
Career Growth Opportunities
Retirement Plan
Requirements
One of the following is required:

Active Ohio Property & Casualty insurance license OR
Demonstrated sales experience (any industry) with a track record of meeting or exceeding goals; and willingness to obtain P&C licensure upon hire.

Additionally:
Strong phone presence and interpersonal communication skills.
Comfortable working with CRM, AI and quoting technology platforms.
Self-motivated with the ability to manage a high volume of leads independently.
Organized and detail-oriented; able to accurately document activity and follow a defined sales process.
Competitive, goal-oriented mindset with a genuine desire to help customers protect their homes.
Responsibilities
Receive and promptly follow up on warm inbound leads generated through our home closing partner network.
Engage prospective customers via phone, text, email, and other communication channels to understand their insurance needs.
Utilize agency technology tools to manage leads, track activity, and move prospects through the sales pipeline.
Present coverage options and obtain agreement from prospects to receive a quote.
Prepare and deliver accurate personal lines insurance quotes.
Close sales and transition new policyholders to the service team for ongoing account management.
Meet or exceed individual sales goals and activity metrics.
Maintain accurate records of all lead activity and client interactions in agency systems.

jobs.title: Women's Health Nurse Practitioner
jobs.body:
Job Title:                      Women’s Health Nurse Practitioner
Service Area:               Health Center
Employment Status:    Part Time, Independent Contractor
Posting Date:               June 30, 2026
Closing Date:               Until Filled

The Medina County Health Department, a nationally accredited health department, has an opening for a part time, independent contractor Women’s Health Nurse Practitioner to provide direct clinical services to individuals receiving medical care in the health center clinics and at collaborating agencies as assigned.  This position will work out of both the Medina and Wadsworth locations as needed.

Essential Job Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Provides certified nurse practitioner services with a focus on women and reproductive health, to individuals within scope of practice.Evaluates patient history, performs physical examinations, and make diagnosis.  Orders, interprets, and evaluates diagnostic tests to identify patient health care needs.Determines and institutes plan of care, including prescribing of therapeutic modalities.Makes referrals to physicians and specialists for treatment and consultation when needed.Documents all care provided in EMR and prepares timely written administrative reports according to agency policy.Consults with the agency Medical Director or SCA Physician Collaborator on medical decision-making as needed and assures SCA is compliant with Ohio Board of Nursing regulations.Supports CDC recommendations on vaccine-preventable diseases and public health best practices.Minimum Education, Training and/or Experience Needs:
Masters of Science in Nursing (minimum) or Doctorate of Nursing Practice, with a Women’s Health Nurse Practitioner specialty.Experience in practice specialty area and hold certification as a Women’s Health Nurse Practitioner.  Minimum of six (6) years of experience preferred.Licensure as a Registered Nurse in Ohio (Section 4723.13 of Ohio Revised Code)Certificate of Authority for Advanced Practice Nursing – Ohio (Section 4723.43 of Ohio Revised Code)Current DEA RegistrationCurrent CPR Certificate To Apply:

Please send a current resume and cover letter to: Debbie Kubena-Yatsko, Executive Director, Health Center, at the Medina County Health Department, 4800 Ledgewood Drive, Medina, Ohio 44256; or e-mail to dkubena-yatsko@medinahealth.org. EOE

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative - FT
jobs.body:
Position Summary:

The successful candidate must have the ability to work independently and as part of a team, demonstrating the ability to work with patience and courtesy in difficult customer relation situations. Must have the ability to communicate effectively; both verbally and in writing, thinking quickly and logically to ensure expedient responses to customer inquiries. Must complete applicable training and display strong organizational skills. The ability to multi-task efficiently and effectively is of paramount importance.

What’s In It For You: 
Competitive hourly wage with free/discounted services
Attractive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k and more, effective immediately upon hire.
Generous paid time off & holidays

What You’ll Be Doing:

Resolve customer issues in a local customer sales and service office environment including billing inquiries, sales opportunities, and product troubleshooting.
Respond to customer correspondence in an appropriate time and manner.
Accurately enter order information for both sales and service orders, updating customer account information including telephone and contact numbers.
Help achieve company sales/upgrade goals by consulting with customers on available products and services.
Daily cash drawer reconciliation 
Use provided training materials and job aids to resolve customer issues quickly and accurately.
Create and maintain customer files including confidential information.
Present a quality presentation of company products and services.
Assist in achieving all system, team, and individual customer service goals and standards.

What You’ll Need:
1-2 years of customer service experience preferred.
Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple conflicting priorities.
Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and make sound judgments and ethical decisions.
Proven ability to develop through coaching and counseling.
Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communications skills.
Regular, punctual, and consistent attendance.
High school diploma or equivalent; advanced degrees or certifications preferred.
Excellent PC and computer applications skills

jobs.body:

Workforce Development Specialist
Jobs for Ohio's Graduates (JOG)
Location: Medina, OH (On-Site)
Salary: $40,000–$45,000 per year
Schedule: Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–4:30 PM

About Jobs for Ohio's Graduates (JOG)
Jobs for Ohio's Graduates (JOG) is dedicated to helping young people complete their education and successfully transition into meaningful employment or post-secondary training. Through mentorship, career readiness, work experience, and life skills training, JOG empowers youth to overcome barriers and achieve long-term success.

Position Overview
As a Workforce Development Specialist, you will mentor and support youth as they work toward educational, career, and personal goals. This role focuses on building relationships, removing barriers, and connecting participants with employment and training opportunities.

Key Responsibilities
Mentor and coach youth as they transition into employment or post-secondary education.Help participants identify and overcome barriers to success.Assess participant needs and develop individualized goal plans.Teach employability, life skills, and workforce readiness competencies.Track participant progress and maintain accurate documentation.Build relationships with employers, schools, and community partners.Collaborate with the JOG team to ensure participant success.Promote JOG's mission, standards, and program objectives.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree required.Experience working with youth required.Strong communication and relationship-building skills.Proficient in:Microsoft OutlookMicrosoft WordMicrosoft ExcelMicrosoft PowerPointOnline database management systemsAbility to travel locally during the day within a five-county service area.Valid driver's license and reliable transportation preferred.Benefits
Medical InsuranceDental InsuranceVision InsuranceLife Insurance401(k) Retirement Plan401(k) Company MatchPaid Time Off (PTO)Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Mileage ReimbursementOn-the-Job Training

Why Join JOG?
Make a meaningful impact in the lives of young people.Help youth overcome barriers and achieve their goals.Work with a supportive, mission-driven team.Be part of an organization that has exceeded national performance standards for over 30 consecutive years.Build strong partnerships with schools, employers, and community organizations while changing lives every day.
